mapper.select: SELECT bdr.business_no as payout_billcode, bdr.dept_id, bdr.dept_name, bdr.emp_id, bdr.emp_name, bdr.amount as execution_amount, bdr.create_time as execution_date FROM budget_detail bdr WHERE bdr.item_id = #{itemId} AND bdr.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND bdr.detail_type = 'PAYOUT' ORDER BY bdr.create_time DESC

SELECT bdr.business_no as apply_no, bdr.dept_id, bdr.dept_name, bdr.emp_id as applicant_id, bdr.emp_name as applicant_name, SUM(bdr.amount) as apply_amount, COALESCE(MAX(execution_summary.executed_amount), 0) as executed_amount, 'APPROVED' as status, MIN(bdr.create_time) as create_time FROM budget_detail bdr LEFT JOIN ( -- 查询每个申请单对应的已执行金额（来自引用该申请单的报账单） SELECT p2.source_apply_no as apply_no, exec_detail.item_id, exec_detail.subject_id, SUM(exec_detail.amount) as executed_amount FROM ctrl_payout p2 INNER JOIN budget_detail exec_detail ON exec_detail.business_no = p2.payout_billcode WHERE p2.source_apply_no IS NOT NULL AND p2.source_apply_no != '' AND exec_detail.detail_type = 'PAYOUT' GROUP BY p2.source_apply_no, exec_detail.item_id, exec_detail.subject_id ) execution_summary ON execution_summary.apply_no = bdr.business_no AND execution_summary.item_id = bdr.item_id AND execution_summary.subject_id = bdr.subject_id WHERE bdr.item_id = #{itemId} AND bdr.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND bdr.detail_type = 'APPLY' GROUP BY bdr.business_no, bdr.dept_id, bdr.dept_name, bdr.emp_id, bdr.emp_name ORDER BY MIN(bdr.create_time) DESC

SELECT exec_detail.business_no as payout_billcode, exec_detail.dept_id, exec_detail.dept_name, exec_detail.emp_id, exec_detail.emp_name, exec_detail.amount as execution_amount, exec_detail.create_time as execution_date FROM budget_detail exec_detail INNER JOIN ctrl_payout p ON p.payout_billcode = exec_detail.business_no WHERE exec_detail.item_id = #{itemId} AND exec_detail.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND exec_detail.detail_type = 'PAYOUT' AND p.source_apply_no = #{applyNo} ORDER BY exec_detail.create_time DESC
